messages.author: 9bbbdf6aed5cf933
messages.subject: lsmeans ref.grid error message
parts:
Hello I am trying to run this line of code:

> lsmeans(RLMMp2, tukey ~  CO2|Treatment)

 and I get the following error message:

Error in lsmeans.character.ref.grid(object = <S4 object of class "ref.grid">,  :
  No variable named CO2 in the reference grid

My mixed model (below) runs fine and CO2 is a column name:

>RLMMp2<- lmer(Grain_Yield~ CO2*PDSIavg* Treatment
              + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), SDdata)

When I print the reference grid, I get this:

>PDSI.model.rg1 <- ref.grid(RLMMp2)
>PDSI.model.rg1
'ref.grid' object with variables:
    CO2 = matrix with column means:
        -0.0051437
    PDSIavg = 0.21352
    Treatment = RWC, RWF, RWL

 I am thinking the problem might be that CO2 is a matrix, but I do not know how to remedy that, as all columns of variables would be 1 dimensional matrices.

messages.author: 9bbbdf6aed5cf933
messages.subject: Re: lsmeans ref.grid error message
parts:
Wait, it could be that CO2 is a continuous variable so the Tukey test does not make sense for a continuous variable.

But, I have found the interaction between CO2 and Treatment to be significant, so does anyone have suggestions on how to go about exploring this interaction for a continuous variable?

Thank you!
